meta.title: Mikman — Router Manager App
meta.description: Mikman is the all-in-one router management application for MikroTik networks. Monitor, configure, and manage your routers from a single dashboard. Get started now at app.mikman.net.

hero.title: Manage Your Routers Like a Pro
hero.subtitle: Mikman gives you full control over your MikroTik routers — monitoring, configuration, and automation — all from one beautiful dashboard.

features.heading: What Mikman Does
features.subheading: Everything you need to manage your network infrastructure, built for speed and simplicity.

items.title: Router Dashboard
items.description: View all your routers at a glance — status, uptime, traffic, and health metrics in real time.

items.title: Configuration Manager
items.description: Edit firewall rules, DHCP settings, queues, and more directly from the web interface.

items.title: Traffic Monitoring
items.description: Visualize bandwidth usage with live charts. Identify bottlenecks and top talkers instantly.

items.title: Multi-Device Support
items.description: Add and manage multiple MikroTik devices from a single account. Scale without friction.

items.title: Alerts & Notifications
items.description: Get notified when a router goes offline, CPU spikes, or a link fails. Stay ahead of issues.

items.title: Secure Access
items.description: API-based communication with your routers over encrypted channels. Your credentials, your control.

plans.heading: Plans & Roadmap
plans.subheading: Start free, upgrade as you grow. Here is what is available now and what is coming.

howToStart.heading: How to Get Started
howToStart.subheading: Three simple steps to take control of your network.

steps.title: Open the App
steps.description: Go to app.mikman.net from any modern browser — desktop or mobile.

steps.title: Add Your Router
steps.description: Enter your MikroTik router IP, username, and password. Mikman connects securely via the REST API.

steps.title: Take Control
steps.description: Monitor traffic, tweak configurations, and manage everything from the dashboard.

footer.tagline: Built for network engineers, by network engineers.
